scope: Migration step 3 first vertical slice: real shared application ownership and typed compiler/renderer/model ports, not the completed multi-backend exit.

ownership.meden-core: Consuming authority kernels. The unused byte/format adapter primitive was removed. No authority transition changed.
ownership.meden-app: Shared source capture, Lake discovery/import binding, compilation/cache, deterministic rendering, meaning assessment/repair, accepted-contract verification, file/shell use cases and host preparation. No model SDK or presentation dependency.
ownership.meden-llm: Actual frozen processor grant and model transports; implements the application model port.
ownership.meden-cli: Composition and public CLI/TUI/GUI adapters; imports the shared use cases.

ports.compiler: Owned bounded request, disjoint Created/Cached result, explicit unique host registrations; frozen and prepared-Lake implementations return decoded snapshots directly. Registration borrows prevent replacement after selection.
ports.meaning: Renderer role with backend-owned validated expression type and decoded Reading; existing actual Informath executes offline.
ports.model: Borrowed session-bound ChatModel calls and diagnostic/status methods. Actual Gateway still consumes the original core call and checks exact session, expiry and revocation; the port cannot approve or renew.

actual_extraction.changes: Only three generated source-location comments changed in Approval.lean and Repair.lean. Generated files were emitted by the actual pinned extraction tools, not edited manually.

journeys: real compiled retained tabs and source/camera/explanations
prepared Lake source/resource refresh and restart
actual offline Atlas scope, meaning and failed-compilation recovery

screens_inspected: provider 429 retained stop and explicit retry
repair source revision changed, retained Finding and restart

deployment: User GUI services were pinned to immutable digest-named validated executables; ordinary Cargo rebuilds no longer replace their worker path. The application candidate is separately pinned for validation.
remaining: A second real verification backend through unchanged generic jobs, admission and viewer paths with required negative cases. Lean frozen/Lake are two configurations, not two verifier kinds.
Complete role-wide plugin/configuration/resource/schema binding and typed failure outcomes.
Backend-neutral bounded inventory/source/graph/job/evidence read models, generated wire definitions and freshness/cross-reference coverage.
Replace/remove legacy demo/duplicate paths only with entry-point, capture and negative-test replacements. Rendering-engine changes remain measurement-driven.
limits: Moving services is not whole-application refinement. Existing authority transitions and proof obligations retain their adapter gaps.
Typed compiler snapshots are still Lean-oriented; this is not yet a universal prover AST or a complete plugin platform.
Scripted model replies validate transport/control integration, not model quality, cold installation or local large-model inference.
